content:
Since it has been one week since the public announcement of Tau Ceti, I pulled some stats from the github repo to see how is the adoption tracking and thought it might be of interest to all

  • Median time to merge < 3h is very promising and so far the review process is scaling. I think the consensus is that 3 hours of agent time is a good tradeoff for the reported quality increase.
  • Most contributions are coming from @Kim Morrison and @Chris Birkbeck but healthy tail of other contributors. Maybe we should have a leaderboard or some other virtual swag to attract more contributors.

I am not planning to do any lean-eval autoformalizations going forward in the future and contribute all my spare tokens to Tau Ceti.

onto week 2.
